scope: Four actual PNG files viewed independently using view_image(detail=original); no generation, image edits, animation, repository changes or user approval

A.perceived_style: Realistic fantasy landscape, detailed photographic/CG look rather than visibly gouache
strengths: Layered foreground ferns/moss, pond and distant moonlit valley create depth
Frog and snail recognizable without cartoon faces
Warm light points balance cool nighttime landscape
limitations: Bright moon and star-like light bursts attract the gaze strongly for a sleep scene
Dense high-contrast foreground details can make it more visually stimulating than C
Do not label as faithful painted/gouache option

B.perceived_style: Realistic cinematic macro / shallow depth of field
strengths: Lowest camera angle at water level is the most immediately immersive
Good separation of foreground drops, frog, midground rocks and blurred forest
Frog and snail both coherent and calm
Central water area provides space for subdued overlay text
limitations: Specular droplets and bright light points are quite sharp/high contrast
Wider forest obscured by strong defocus, which is a style choice rather than missing detail

C.perceived_style: Clearly hand-painted illustration look with visible paper/paint texture, muted colors
strengths: Strongest distinct painterly treatment among A/B/C
Dense natural detail remains harmonious rather than overly glossy
Dusk colors and softer contrast suit calm adult bedtime stories
Frog, snail, plants and reflective pond are visually coherent
limitations: Still visually dense; animation should remain restrained to preserve calm
No claim of scientific botanical accuracy; generated illustrative flora

avatar.perceived_style: Painterly emblem: golden crescent, fern, moss and small firefly on dark teal background
strengths: Crescent and fern create clear natural/night identity without child-oriented cartoon features
Generous surrounding dark margin; main motif fits a centered circular crop with room
Gold moon remains the strongest recognizable shape at small scale
limitations: Tiny firefly and detailed moss/fern texture will lose detail at mobile icon size
Centering assessment is visual; no measured segmentation or actual circle crop produced
avatar.circular_crop_visual_assessment: Main subject remains safely inside central circle; no obvious clipping risk
